preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid) and all(len(row) == len(grid[0]) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: grid is a non-empty rectangular 2D array of lowercase English letters

preconditions.expression: all(len(grid) >= 1 and len(grid[0]) >= 1 for _ in grid)
all(all(isinstance(cell, str) and len(cell) == 1 and cell.islower() for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: every cell in grid is a single lowercase English letter

postconditions.expression: any(any(any(any(any(containsCycleHelper(grid, i, j, i, j, -1, -1) for j in range(len(grid[0]))) for i in range(len(grid))) for _ in range(4)) for _ in range(4)))
postconditions.description: returns true if and only if there exists a cycle of length ≥4 where all cells have the same value, and no two consecutive moves are backtracking (i.e., no immediate reversal of direction)
